answer: Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Because the forge weight is recomputed from the horizon history each close, the canyon audit reveals the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 9 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 42% of full weight. That is 13 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
